data.title: 爱西亚 · 浅海清波中荷叶边泳衣的羞涩戏水
data.description: 热带清澈见底的浅滩上，爱西亚穿着保守而纯洁的纯白荷叶边连体泳衣，双手小心翼翼捧起海水，微风吹拂金色发丝。
data.location: 清澈如琉璃的热带海滨浅滩
data.action: 站在及踝海水中微屈双膝，双手舀起透明海水，羞涩地转头注视，双颊泛起粉嫩红晕
data.lighting: 明净的白日日光，海水波光折射出剔透如宝石的微芒
data.camera: 全身侧视，构图纯粹干净，突显无邪少女感
data.promptProse: Asia Argento wades shyly through the crystal-clear ankle-deep turquoise shallows of a tranquil tropical beach. She is dressed in a modest pure-white one-piece swimsuit adorned with delicate ruffled trims along the neckline and hips. Cupping clear seawater between her trembling hands, she glances up toward the viewer with rosy cheeks and innocent, bashful emerald eyes beneath warm summer sunlight.
data.animaCaption: Asia wades hesitantly through sparkling turquoise shallows, shyly cupping crystal water with flushed cheeks under the tropical sun.
